title: cousinia pergamacea subsp. sardashtensis
intro: Cousinia pergamacea subsp. sardashtensis, commonly known as Sardasht Cousinia, is a plant species endemic to Iran and used in traditional medicine. It is valued for its various health benefits, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-bacterial properties, which can help to protect against oxidative stress, reduce inflammation, and combat infections. The therapeutic actions of Sardasht Cousinia include its ability to stimulate digestion, improve wound healing, and exhibit anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
